entities.summary: Marco Antonio Muñiz, known by the stage name Marc Anthony, is an American singer and actor. He is the top selling salsa artist of all time. A four-time Grammy Award, eight-time Latin Grammy Award and twenty-nine-time Lo Nuestro Awards winner. As of 2014, he had sold more than 12 million albums worldwide.
